housing-numbers.notes: Target of 8,850 homes for 2018-2037 period from former Draft GMSF, with 466 per year average (370 per year 2018-2023, then 500 per year 2024-2037). Godley Green Garden Village identified as strategic site with potential for up to 2,150 new homes. Housing Delivery Test required 588 net additional homes for 2019/20. New Standard Method suggests around 750 net new homes would be needed.
